hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: VERSION
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description:
예: v1.0.0
x.0.0 - 대규모 업데이트 0.x.0 - 소규모 패치 0.0.x - 핫픽스

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
set -e BK="protractor-backend:${VERSION}" FE="protractor-frontend:${VERSION}"
# 프론트 RUM (브라우저 노출용 공개 토큰) RUM_APP_ID=3ef01d23-62f5-4dfc-90a5-a5372c318b93 RUM_CLIENT_TOKEN=pub5ab2bc6be03310368795b538a6dd1bc2 RUM_SITE=ap1.datadoghq.com
# 빌드 (backend: Dockerfile에 java agent 포함 / frontend: RUM 주입) docker image inspect "$BK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker build -t "$BK" ./backend docker image inspect "$FE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker build \ --build-arg VITE_DD_RUM_APP_ID="$RUM_APP_ID" \ --build-arg VITE_DD_RUM_CLIENT_TOKEN="$RUM_CLIENT_TOKEN" \ --build-arg VITE_DD_SITE="$RUM_SITE" \ -t "$FE" ./frontend
# .env의 PROD_*_IMAGE만 갱신 (DD_API_KEY 등 나머지 보존!) touch /app-deploy/.env sed -i '/^PROD_BACKEND_IMAGE=/d; /^PROD_FRONTEND_IMAGE=/d' /app-deploy/.env cat >> /app-deploy/.env <<EOF2 PROD_BACKEND_IMAGE=${BK} PROD_FRONTEND_IMAGE=${FE} EOF2
# 오버레이 포함해 운영 컨테이너 교체 (backend-prod에 DD env 병합됨) docker compose -p app \ -f /app-deploy/docker-compose.yml -f /app-deploy/docker-compose.datadog.yml \ --project-directory /app-deploy \ up -d --no-deps --force-recreate backend-prod frontend-prod
# 버전 이미지 5개 초과분 정리 for repo in protractor-backend protractor-frontend; do docker images "$repo" --format '{{.Tag}}' | grep '^v' | sort -Vr | tail -n +6 \ | while read t; do docker rmi "$repo:$t" 2>/dev/null || true; done done
